rows.evidence_quote: The AST_L1T product is GIS-ready data produced using a single resampling from the AST_L1A input scene.

supporting_quotes.quote: The AST_L1T uses the appended radiometric and geometric corrections in the AST_L1A product and cross-talk corrections as the systematic basis on which to apply the terrain and precision corrections.

supporting_quotes.section: User Guide §8.2 Collection 2 Ground Control Points and Input DEMs
supporting_quotes.quote: ASTER L1T processing begins with ASTER Level 1A input data and applies Landsat-derived geometric algorithms
provides GIS-ready data with a single resampling from the ASTER Level 1A product (AST_L1A).
The AST_L1T is created from a single resampling of the corresponding ASTER L1A ([AST_L1A](https://doi.org/10.5067/ASTER/AST_L1A.004)) product.

rows.keyword_priority_note: 'produced using a single resampling from the AST_L1A input scene' (priority 1).
rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q2 yes: AST_L1T is AST_L1A's data, calibrated and resampled once -> derived_from (PARENT). PARENT vs INPUT: reprocessing AST_L1A changes every AST_L1T radiance, so PARENT, not INPUT.
rows.confidence_rule: HIGH rule: source, statement and CMR validation all strong

rows.evidence_quote: then the AST_L1B code which applies the inter- and intra- telescope registration correction, radiometric coefficients,

supporting_quotes.quote: An AST_L1T that has achieved systematic correction is essentially a rotated AST_L1B.
which corresponds with the ASTER Level 1B ([AST_L1B](https://doi.org/10.5067/ASTER/AST_L1B.004)) that has been geometrically corrected and rotated to a north-up UTM projection.

supporting_quotes.section: L1T ATBD Algorithm Description, ASTER Level 1B Algorithm
supporting_quotes.quote: The ASTER Level 1B (AST_L1B) algorithm applies the radiometric calibration coefficients that are calculated and appended, but not applied to the distributed AST_L1A data product.

rows.keyword_priority_note: 'then the AST_L1B code which applies ...' (shared code; priority 3).
rows.decision_procedure: Same as the AST_L1B -> AST_L1T row: not a parent (L1T is not made from L1B granules), not the same run -> related_to (RELATED).
rows.mapping_note: The CMR abstract's 'corresponds with the ASTER Level 1B ... that has been geometrically corrected' reads like a parent link but the ATBD, User Guide and Quick Reference Guide all say the input is AST_L1A.
rows.confidence_rule: MEDIUM rule: document-supported; weak criteria = statement
